## Checklist

- [ ] Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (typecheck, lint, unit tests)
- [ ] `pnpm build` produces a loadable extension
- [ ] Added or updated tests for any behavior change
- [ ] Added or updated translations in `public/_locales` for any new
      user-facing string
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
      (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, ...) — releases and the changelog are
      generated from them
